# Scout

> A free fictional card comparison lab for people and browser agents. Every card, seller, listing, sale, and price is synthetic. No live marketplace is connected.

The fixed sample is dated August 29, 2026. Use keyword searches such as Ember Dragon ex, Volt Lynx PSA 10, or Tide Oracle raw. Search filters apply to matching listings. Raw/graded tier summaries remain separate. Reload resets selections.

## Page-side WebMCP tools

- search_cards: keyword search and exact grade, budget, trust, discount filters; returns matching listing IDs grouped by card.
- get_card_market_state: all exact-tier statistics and listings for a canonical card.
- assess_listing: one listing's costs, scores, seller evidence, and risks.
- compare_listings: two to five unique listing IDs; withheld scores cannot select a winner.
- find_deals: the same filters returning listings, with optional query.
- compare_raw_vs_graded: separate raw conditions and graded company/grade tiers.

Tools register through document.modelContext when available. They are read-only over the sample, return synthetic provenance and limitations, and update the visible workspace. Manual workflows work without WebMCP. This is not a remote MCP server.

## Boundaries

Known shipping is included; taxes and unknown shipping are excluded. A rolling median needs three non-anomalous exact sales. Scores illustrate a methodology and do not value or authenticate real cards. No accounts, saved searches, imports, purchases, or live-provider integrations are implemented.
